device.name: iPhone 16 Pro Max
device.evidence: raw/smoke/smoke_base.log (env record), read via sysctlbyname from inside the benchmark process

app.note: ONE binary is used for both A and B; the configuration is selected per process by the BENCH_SME2 environment variable, which calls xnn_internal_set_arm_sme2(1) before the first XNNPACK initialization.

runtime.genaic_binary: MediaPipeTasksGenAIC.xcframework/ios-arm64: a static archive (ar) of 3044 Mach-O objects, 57,745,000 bytes, statically linked into the app
runtime.inference_stack: Swift LlmInference -> MediaPipe llm_inference_engine -> odml::infra::LlmLiteRTExecutor (LiteRT-LM) -> TFLite/LiteRT interpreter + XNNPACK delegate -> XNNPACK ukernels / KleidiAI micro-kernels
runtime.xnnpack_snapshot: between google/XNNPACK commits 8a396b78d1 (2025-06-12, 'Disable ARM SME2 support by default': xnn_enable_arm_sme2_default=0) and 001e5b57d2 (2025-06-23, removed xnn_internal_set_arm_sme2). Evidence: binary contains xnn_enable_arm_sme2_default in __common (zero) and xnn_internal_set_arm_sme2 with the tbnz-lock semantics of that window.
runtime.kleidiai: present (1903 kai_* symbols in the archive; version string not embedded). Families: neon_dotprod, neon_i8mm, sme (packing), sme2_mopa, sme2_sdot, sme2_dot, sme2_mla.
runtime.tflite_runtime_version_string: unknown (no version string embedded); litert::lm namespaces present
